sentences.text: The case of the prosecution is that, the Project Officer of Sri. Kshetra Dharmasthala Gramabhipradi Yojana, B. C. Trust Aurad, lodged the First Information Report on 16.07.2022 stating that, the Trust is rendering financial assistance to the members of self-help group having its account in Pragathi Krishna Grameena Bank, Aurad.
The said account is in the joint name of Taluka Project Officer, Finance Manager and Administrative Assistant Manager.

The accused No.1 who is the Administrative Assistant Manager of Aurad Branch, transferred the amount belonging to the Trust into his personal account and account of other persons by committing forgery and has Shivakumar vs The State Of Karnataka on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101822769/
2 siphoned of Rs.1,15,00,000/-, out of which he had refunded Rs.20,00,000/-.

sentences.text: 03. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner - accused and the learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent - State.
The contention of the petitioner's is that, the police are visiting his house stating that, an amount of Rs.20,00,000/- is transferred into his account by accused No.1.
The case of forgery and cheating is against accused No.1.
Whether the accused No.1 has connived with the petitioner - accused herein in forging and cheating the complainant, is a matter which requires to be investigated.

At this stage,
the petitioner - accused herein has made out a prima-facie case to enlarge him on bail, in the event of his arrest.

Accordingly, I pass the following;
ORDER
The Criminal Petition is allowed.
